claim: Higher sea-level-rise scenarios increase mangrove exposure to hazardous RSLR rates and composite risk.
Composite risk hotspots are geographically concentrated rather than globally uniform.
Historical intense tropical cyclone regime pressure strongly shapes the upper tail of the composite index.
A substantial fraction of sampled global mangrove area exceeds 4 mm/yr and 7 mm/yr RSLR under late-century higher-emissions scenarios.
